(define (db-after-op! db)
  (let ((o (vector-ref db 7)))
    (if (obs:closed! o) (begin (obs:reset-closed! o) (db-sync-cache-policy! db) (db-hook! db "window")) #f)))
(define (db-bump! db name n)
  (let ((v (vector-ref db 6)) (i (db-stat-index name)))
    (vector-set! v i (+ n (vector-ref v i)))
    (if (equal? name "sst_bytes_written") (obs:note-sst-bytes! (vector-ref db 7) n) #f)))
(define (db-write! db type key val)
  (if (= (string-length key) 0) (ru:fail "empty key") #f)
  (db-bump! db "wal_bytes" (wal:append! (db:wal-path db) type key val (db:opt db "sync")))
  (mem:put! (vector-ref db 1) key type val)
  (if (>= (mem:bytes (vector-ref db 1)) (db:opt db "memtable_bytes")) (db:flush! db) #f)
  #t)
(define (obs:put! o key del? bytes ms)
  (obs-bump! o (if del? c-dels c-puts) 1)
  (if (and (not del?) (string<? (vector-ref o 2) key)) (obs-bump! o c-seq 1) #f)
  (if del? #f (vector-set! o 2 key))
  (vector-set! o 9 (+ (vector-ref o 9) bytes))
  (obs-bump! o c-put-ms ms)
  (obs-trace! o (if del? 1 0) key)
  (obs-op! o))

(define UNSET (list 'unset))

  (if (assigned? asg v)

      #f))
(define (csp-unassign! c v asg)
  (if (and (vector-ref c 4) (assigned? asg v)) (record-conflict! c v (assignment-ref asg v) -1) #f)
  (asg-del! asg v))

(define (arg-at args i)
  (if (>= i (length args))
    #f
    (list-ref args i)))
(define (ascii-upcase s)
  (let ((n (string-length s))
        (i 0)
        (chars (list)))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
          (if (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122))
            (set! chars (cons (- c 32) chars))
            (set! chars (cons c chars)))
          (set! i (+ i 1)))))
    (list->string (reverse chars))))
(define (parse-set-opts args)
  ; Returns (list value expire-at-ms nx xx) — expire-at 0 means none; nx/xx are #t/#f
  ; args = (SET key value [EX sec|PX ms] [NX|XX] ...)
  (let ((val (arg-at args 2))
        (ex-ms 0)
        (nx #f)
        (xx #f)
        (i 3)
        (n (length args))
        (ok #t))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< i n)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((o (ascii-upcase (list-ref args i))))
          (cond
            ((string=? o "EX")
             (let ((sec (string->number (arg-at args (+ i 1)))))
               (if (number? sec)
                 (begin (set! ex-ms (* sec 1000)) (set! i (+ i 2)))
                 (set! ok #f))))
            ((string=? o "PX")
             (let ((ms (string->number (arg-at args (+ i 1)))))
               (if (number? ms)
                 (begin (set! ex-ms ms) (set! i (+ i 2)))
                 (set! ok #f))))
            ((string=? o "NX")
             (set! nx #t) (set! i (+ i 1)))
            ((string=? o "XX")
             (set! xx #t) (set! i (+ i 1)))
            (else (set! ok #f))))))
    (if (and ok (string? val))
      (list val
            (if (> ex-ms 0) (+ (current-time-ms) ex-ms) 0)

      #f)))

(define (kg-cond t env loops)
  (cond
    ((and (string? t) (string=? t "#t")) (kg-ok "1"))
    ((and (string? t) (string=? t "#f")) (kg-ok "0"))
    ((or (string? t) (null? t) (not (string? (car t))))
     (kg-err "condition is not a comparison (Aura truthiness of Int differs from C)"))
    ((and (kg-cmp? (car t)) (= (kg-len (cdr t)) 2))
     (let ((a (kg-expr (car (cdr t)) env loops)) (b (kg-expr (car (cdr (cdr t))) env loops)))
       (cond ((not (kg-ok? a)) a) ((not (kg-ok? b)) b)
             (else (kg-ok (string-append "(" (kg-val a) " " (if (string=? (car t) "=") "==" (car t)) " " (kg-val b) ")"))))))
    ((string=? (car t) "and") (kg-logic "&&" (cdr t) env loops))
    ((string=? (car t) "or") (kg-logic "||" (cdr t) env loops))
    ((and (string=? (car t) "not") (= (kg-len (cdr t)) 1))
     (let ((r (kg-cond (car (cdr t)) env loops))) (if (kg-ok? r) (kg-ok (string-append "(!" (kg-val r) ")")) r)))

(define (now-ms) (current-time-ms))
(define (times n thunk) (if (<= n 0) #t (begin (thunk n) (times (- n 1) thunk))))
(define admit (lambda (name body) #f))
(define guarded-root-apply! (lambda (name body0 why) #f))
(define materialize (lambda () #f))
(define retry-limit (lambda (tool err) #f))
(define static-check (lambda (name body) #f))
(define trial-snap (lambda (name body0 why) #f))
(define trial-ws (lambda (name body0 why . keep) #f))
(define t0 (current-time-ms))
(define *version* 0)
(define *log* (list))
(define bench-a "(lambda (tool err) (cond ((and (equal? tool \"sql\") (equal? err \"rate-limit\")) 3) (else 1)))")
(define bench-b "(lambda (tool err) (cond ((and (equal? tool \"sql\") (equal? err \"rate-limit\")) 2) (else 1)))")
(define (us-per n thunk) (let ((t0 (now-ms))) (times n thunk) (/ (* 1000.0 (- (now-ms) t0)) n)))
(define (bench n)
  (let* ((v0 *version*) (l0 *log*) (s0 (ast:snapshot "bench-base"))
         (r-call (us-per (* 50 n) (lambda (i) (retry-limit "sql" "rate-limit"))))
         (r-mat (us-per n (lambda (i) (materialize))))
         (r-static (us-per (* 10 n) (lambda (i) (static-check "retry-limit" bench-a))))
         (r-admit (us-per (* 10 n) (lambda (i) (admit "retry-limit" bench-a))))
         (r-rebind (us-per n (lambda (i) (mutate:rebind "retry-limit" (if (even? i) bench-a bench-b) "bench") (eval-current))))
         (r-snap (us-per n (lambda (i) (ast:snapshot "bench"))))
         (r-restore (us-per n (lambda (i) (ast:restore s0) (eval-current))))

(define (pj-str s)
  (let loop ((i 0) (start 0) (acc "\""))
    (if (>= i (string-length s))
        (string-append acc (substring s start i) "\"")
        (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
          (cond ((= c 34) (loop (+ i 1) (+ i 1) (string-append acc (substring s start i) "\\\"")))
                ((= c 92) (loop (+ i 1) (+ i 1) (string-append acc (substring s start i) "\\\\")))
                ((= c 10) (loop (+ i 1) (+ i 1) (string-append acc (substring s start i) "\\n")))
                (else (loop (+ i 1) start acc)))))))
(define (pj-val v)
  (cond ((equal? v #t) "true")
        ((equal? v #f) "false")
        ((string? v) (pj-str v))
        ((number? v) (number->string v))
        ((null? v) "[]")
        ((pair? v) (let loop ((xs v) (acc "[") (first #t))
                     (if (null? xs) (string-append acc "]")
                         (loop (cdr xs) (string-append acc (if first "" ",") (pj-val (car xs))) #f))))
        (else "null")))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (let ((ex (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
        (e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (and e (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "v" val)
        (hash-set! e "ex" ex)
        #t)
      (let ((entry (hash)))
        (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
        (hash-set! entry "v" val)
        (hash-set! entry "ex" ex)
        (hash-set! db key entry)
        #t))))
(define (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          e
          (if (> ex (current-time-ms))
            e
            (begin

(define resp-encode-int (lambda (n) #f))

(define *RESP-NULL* "$-1\r\n")
(define (resp-encode-array items)
  (let ((n (length items))
        (body "")

    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))

         (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "error") (resp-encode-error (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (resp-encode-bulk (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") *RESP-NULL*)
    ((string=? (car v) "array") (resp-encode-array (car (cdr v))))
    (else (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))

  (vector-set! c 7 (+ (vector-ref c 7) 1))
  ((vector-ref c 3) A a B b))
(define (curr c v) (vector-ref (vector-ref c 5) v))
(define (prune! c v x rem)
  (vector-set! (vector-ref c 5) v (remove-first x (curr c v)))
  (if rem (vector-set! rem 0 (cons (list v x) (vector-ref rem 0))) #f))
(define csp-n (lambda (c) #f))
(define csp-support-pruning! (lambda (c) #f))
(define neighbors (lambda (c v) #f))
(define remove-first (lambda (x xs) #f))
(define (revise! c xi xj rem)
  (let lp ((xs (curr c xi)) (revised #f))
    (if (null? xs) revised
        (let ((x (car xs)))
          (if (let any ((ys (curr c xj))) (cond ((null? ys) #f) ((constraint? c xi x xj (car ys)) #t) (else (any (cdr ys)))))
              (lp (cdr xs) revised)
              (begin (prune! c xi x rem) (lp (cdr xs) #t)))))))
(define (ac3 c)
  (csp-support-pruning! c)
  (let ((q (let lp ((v (- (csp-n c) 1)) (acc '()))
             (if (< v 0) acc (lp (- v 1) (append (map (lambda (k) (list v k)) (neighbors c v)) acc))))))
    (let loop ((q q))
      (if (null? q) #t
          (let ((xi (car (car q))) (xj (cadr (car q))))
            (if (revise! c xi xj #f)
                (if (null? (curr c xi)) #f
                    (loop (append (cdr q)
                                  (let add ((ks (neighbors c xi)) (acc '()))
                                    (cond ((null? ks) (reverse acc))
                                          ((or (= (car ks) xj) (member (list (car ks) xi) q)) (add (cdr ks) acc))

  (cond ((string? x) x)

  (if (or (not *learn*) *pending* (equal? op ""))
      #f
      (let* ((key (key-of fs))
             (cls (classify (field fs 1) (field fs 2) (field fs 3) (field fs 4)))
             (n (hash-ref *evidence* (string-append key "\t" op) 0))
             (tot (hash-ref *key-total* key 0))
             (pure (and (>= n *min-evidence*) (>= (* 4 n) (* 3 tot)) (not (equal? op (top-op fs)))))
             (sbk (string-append "specialize\t" key "\t" op))

              (can-spec (propose! "specialize" fs op sbk n))

(define (score-round probe arg reps)
  (let ((t0 (current-time-ms)))
    (let loop ((i 0))
      (if (< i reps)
          (begin (probe arg) (loop (+ i 1)))
          0))
    (- (current-time-ms) t0)))
(define score:check (lambda (probe golden) #f))
(define *score-rounds* 1)
(define (score:bench probe arg reps)
  (let warm ((i 0)) (if (< i (+ 1 (quotient reps 4))) (begin (probe arg) (warm (+ i 1))) 0))
  (let loop ((k 1) (best (score-round probe arg reps)))
    (if (>= k *score-rounds*) best
        (let ((t (score-round probe arg reps))) (loop (+ k 1) (if (< t best) t best))))))

  (let ((bad (score:check probe golden))
        (det (try (equal? (probe bench-arg) (probe bench-arg)) (catch (e) #f))))
    (let ((t-after (if (and (= bad 0) det) (score:bench probe bench-arg reps) 0)))

                               (if (and (= bad 0) det (< speedup min-speedup))
                                   (list "too-slow")
                                   (list)))))

(define (pad:gsim plan tag print)
  (let ((unk (pad:goal-unkind plan)))
    (let loop ((cs (pad:expand plan))
               (i 0)
               (L (pad:start-lines))
               (l 0)
               (col 0)
               (keys 0)
               (rej 0))
      (if (null? cs)
          (let ((d (pad:dist-lines L *g-goal-lines*)))
            (list (- *g-base* (+ keys (* 2 rej) (* 3 d) (* 4 unk)))
                  keys rej d unk L l col))
          (let* ((c (car cs))
                 (reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
            (if (string=? reason "ok")
                (let ((st (pad:lapply c L l col)))
                  (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1)
                        (car st) (car (cdr st)) (car (cdr (cdr st)))
                        (+ keys 1) rej))
                (begin
                  (if (and (= print 1) (< rej 4))
                      (pad:lreject! (+ i 1) c reason tag))
                  (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1) L l col keys (+ rej 1)))))))))

      (let* ((src (string-append

             (sc (try (set-code src) (catch (e) e))))
        (if (not (equal? sc #t))

        ((hash-has-key? claims i)

(define (resp-parse-bulk buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((len (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? len))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR bulk len"))
          (if (< len 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((data-start (+ cr 2))
                  (need (+ cr 2 len 2)))
              (if (> need n)
                #f
                (list need
                      (list "bulk"
                            (substring buf data-start (+ data-start len))))))))))))
(define (resp-parse-line buf i n t)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((payload (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))
            (next (+ cr 2)))
        (cond
          ((= t 43) (list next (list "simple" payload)))
          ((= t 45) (list next (list "error" payload)))
          (else
           (let ((num (string->number payload)))
             (if (number? num)
               (list next (list "int" num))
               (list next (list "error" "ERR int"))))))))))
(define resp-find-crlf (lambda (buf start) #f))
(define (resp-try-parse buf i)
  (let ((n (string-length buf)))
    (if (>= i n)
      #f
      (let ((t (string-ref buf i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= t 43) (= t 45) (= t 58))
           (resp-parse-line buf i n t))
          ((= t 36)
           (resp-parse-bulk buf i n))
          ((= t 42)
           (resp-parse-array buf i n))
          (else
           (list (+ i 1) (list "error" "ERR protocol"))))))))
(define (resp-parse-array buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((alen (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? alen))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR array len"))
          (if (< alen 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((pos (+ cr 2))
                  (items (list))
                  (k 0)
                  (ok #t)
                  (fail #f))
              (while (lambda () (and ok (< k alen)))
                (lambda ()
                  (let ((r (resp-try-parse buf pos)))
                    (if (not r)
                      (begin (set! ok #f) (set! fail #t))
                      (begin
                        (set! pos (car r))
                        ; cons + reverse (not append) — O(n) not O(n²)
                        (set! items (cons (car (cdr r)) items))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))))
              (if fail
                #f
                (list pos (list "array" (reverse items)))))))))))

(define (pad:ai-keep xs n)
  (let ((k (length xs)))
    (if (<= k n) xs (pad:ai-drop xs (- k n)))))
(define pad:ai-complete (lambda (sys hist user) #f))
(define pad:ai-live (lambda () #f))
(define pad:ai-page (lambda () #f))
(define pad:ai-plain-s (lambda (s) #f))
(define pad:ai-show! (lambda (say) #f))
(define pad:ai-drop (lambda (xs n) #f))
(define *ai-hist* (list))
(define *ai-sys-ask*
  "You help a child in aura-pad. The page shows only plain English letters, digits, and punctuation. Answer in a few short sentences of plain English.")
(define *pl-say* "")
(define page
  (string-append ";; keep this\n\n"
    (string-append "(define (hello x)\n  (+ x 1))\n"
      "(define (main) (hello 3))\n")))
(define (pad:ai-remember! user-text shown answer)
  (set! *ai-hist*
        (pad:ai-keep
         (append *ai-hist*
                 (list (list "user" user-text shown)
                       (list "assistant" answer answer)))
         8))
  0)
(define (pad:ai-ask! q)
  (let ((page (pad:ai-page)))
    (if (and (string=? q "") (string=? page ""))
        (begin (set! *pl-say* "tell the chat what to ask") "vi-do")
        (let* ((shown (if (string=? q "") "explain this page" q))
               (user (if (string=? page "")
                         shown
                         (string-append shown "\n\nThe page says:\n" page)))
               (back (pad:ai-live))
               (r (pad:ai-complete *ai-sys-ask* *ai-hist* user)))
          (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
              (begin (set! *pl-say* (cadr r)) "vi-do")
              (let ((ans (pad:ai-plain-s (cadr r))))
                (if (string=? ans "")
                    (begin (set! *pl-say* "the chat had nothing to say") "vi-do")
                    (begin
                      (pad:ai-remember! user shown ans)
                      (pad:ai-show!
                       (if (or (string=? back "") (string=? back "chat"))
                           "the chat answered"
                           (string-append "the chat answered. M-x switch:"
                                          back " goes back")))))))))))

(define (pad:pack-strict p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))

(define pad:key-arg (lambda (k) #f))
(define pad:key-op (lambda (k) #f))
(define pad:papply (lambda (p op arg buf point) #f))
(define pad:score-of (lambda (edits rejects dist) #f))
(define pad:seed-step (lambda (seed) #f))
(define pad:pack-step (lambda (p) #f))
(define *steps* 24)
(define *seed* 20261005)
(define *goal* (list 104 105 32 97 117 114 97))
(define *buf* (list))
(define *point* 0)
(define *dist* 0)
(define *score* 0)
(define *slot-tag* "none")
(define *room-boost* 0)
(define *live-r* 0)
(define *key* 0)
(define *live-edits* 0)
(define *live-rej* 0)
(define *live-shown* 0)
(define (pad:pgate p op arg buf point)
  (let ((len (length buf))
        (mx (pad:pack-room p))
        (st (= (pad:pack-strict p) 1)))
    (cond
      ((and (= op 0) (= point 0) st) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 1) (>= point len) st) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 3) (= point 0)) "empty-line")
      ((and (= op 2) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 4) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 2) st (> (modulo arg 30) 25)) "not-print")
      (#t "ok"))))
(define (pad:psim p)
  (let loop ((i 0)
             (r (pad:seed-step *seed*))
             (buf (list))
             (pt 0)
             (edits 0)
             (rejs 0))
    (if (>= i *steps*)
        (let ((d (pad:dist buf *goal*)))
          (list (pad:score-of edits rejs d) edits rejs d buf pt))
        (let* ((op (pad:key-op r))
               (arg (pad:key-arg r))
               (reason (pad:pgate p op arg buf pt)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let ((st (pad:papply p op arg buf pt)))
                (loop (+ i 1) (pad:seed-step r)
                      (car st) (car (cdr st)) (+ edits 1) rejs))
              (loop (+ i 1) (pad:seed-step r) buf pt edits (+ rejs 1)))))))
(define (pad:live-key! p tag)
  (set! *slot-tag* tag)
  (let* ((r *live-r*)
         (op (pad:key-op r))
         (arg (pad:key-arg r))
         (pk (list (pad:pack-step p)
                   (+ (pad:pack-room p) *room-boost*)
                   (pad:pack-strict p)))
         (reason (pad:pgate pk op arg *buf* *point*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (let ((st (pad:papply pk op arg *buf* *point*)))
          (set! *buf* (car st))
          (set! *point* (car (cdr st)))
          (set! *live-edits* (+ *live-edits* 1)))
        (begin
          (set! *live-rej* (+ *live-rej* 1))
          (if (< *live-shown* 4)
              (begin
                (set! *live-shown* (+ *live-shown* 1))
                (display "REJECT mid=0 reason=")
                (display reason)
                (display " key=")
                (display (number->string (+ *key* 1)))
                (display " slot=")
                (display tag)
                (newline)))))
    (set! *live-r* (pad:seed-step r))
    (set! *key* (+ *key* 1))
    (set! *dist* (pad:dist *buf* *goal*))
    (set! *score* (pad:score-of *live-edits* *live-rej* *dist*))
    (if (= *key* 8)
        (begin
          (set! *room-boost* 2)
          (display "MUTATE key=8 room-boost=2 slot=")
          (display tag)
          (newline)))
    *key*))

(define (db-bump! db name n)
  (let ((v (vector-ref db 6)) (i (db-stat-index name)))
    (vector-set! v i (+ n (vector-ref v i)))
    (if (equal? name "sst_bytes_written") (obs:note-sst-bytes! (vector-ref db 7) n) #f)))
(define (db-file db num ext) (ru:path (vector-ref db 0) (string-append (ru:pad num 6) ext)))
(define (db-new-file-num! db) (let ((n (vector-ref db 3))) (vector-set! db 3 (+ n 1)) n))
(define (db:opt db key) (db-opt-in (vector-ref db 5) key))
(define (ru:rev xs) (let loop ((xs xs) (acc (list))) (if (null? xs) acc (loop (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
(define (sst:open path)
  (let ((data (rio:read path)))
    (if (not data) (ru:fail "cannot read " path) #f)

(define (bg-job-done j) (bg-nth j 5))
(define (bg:job-kinds j) (bg-nth j 1))
(define (bg:job-name j) (bg-nth j 0))
(define (bg:job-ret j) (bg-nth j 2))
(define (bg:job-so j) (bg-nth j 3))
(define (bg:job-symbol j) (bg-nth j 4))
(define bg-root (lambda () #f))
(define bg:hash (lambda (s) #f))
(define vkgen:base (lambda (name) #f))
(define vkgen:compile (lambda (name tree kinds) #f))
(define vkgen:symbol (lambda (name) #f))
(define bg:job-status (lambda (j) #f))
(define bg-nth (lambda (xs k) #f))
(define fixture:root (lambda () #f))
(define r #f)
(define dir (string-append (fixture:root) "/build/gen"))
(define (bg-with-status j st reason)
  (list (bg:job-name j) (bg:job-kinds j) (bg:job-ret j) (bg:job-so j) (bg:job-symbol j) (bg-job-done j) st reason))
(define (bg:launch! name tree kinds)
  (let ((r (vkgen:compile name tree kinds)))
    (if (not (car r))
        (list name kinds #f "" "" "" "skipped" (car (cdr r)))
        (let* ((src (car (cdr r))) (ret (car (cdr (cdr r))))
               (base (string-append (vkgen:base name) "_" (number->string (bg:hash src))))
               (dir (string-append (bg-root) "/build/gen-bg"))
               (cpath (string-append dir "/" base ".c"))
               (so (string-append (bg-root) "/build/kernels/lib" base ".so"))
               (done (string-append dir "/" base ".done"))
               (log (string-append dir "/" base ".log"))
               (job (list name kinds ret so (vkgen:symbol name) done "pending" "")))
          (if (file-exists? so)
              (bg-with-status job "cached" "")
              (begin
                (shell (string-append "mkdir -p " dir " " (bg-root) "/build/kernels && rm -f " done))
                (write-file cpath src)
                (shell (string-append "( " (bg-root) "/kernels/build_one.sh " cpath " " so " > " log " 2>&1; echo $? > " done ".tmp; mv " done ".tmp " done " ) > /dev/null 2>&1 &"))
                job))))))
(define (bg:poll j)
  (if (and (equal? (bg:job-status j) "pending") (file-exists? (bg-job-done j)))
      (let ((code (read-file (bg-job-done j))))
        (if (and (string? code) (> (string-length code) 0) (= (string-ref code 0) 48))
            (bg-with-status j "ok" "")
            (bg-with-status j "fail" (string-append "cc failed, see " (bg-job-done j) " / .log"))))
      j))

        ((member a *wrapped*) (string-append "%" a))

(define (dispatch-client sock)
  (if (sync-clients?)
    (serve-client sock)
    (let ((fid (fiber:spawn (lambda () (serve-client sock)))))
      (if (and (integer? fid) (> fid 0))
        #t
        (begin
          (display "aura-redis: fiber:spawn failed; serving sync (set AURA_REDIS_SYNC=1 to silence)\n")
          (serve-client sock))))))
(define (sync-clients?)
  (let ((env (getenv "AURA_REDIS_SYNC")))
    (and (string? env)
         (or (string=? env "1")
             (string=? env "true")
             (string=? env "yes")))))
(define serve-client (lambda (sock) #f))
(define (server-loop port)
  (let ((L (tcp-listen port))
        (mode (if (sync-clients?) "sequential" "fiber-per-client")))
    (if (not (integer? L))
      (begin
        (display "aura-redis: tcp-listen failed (need AURA_SANDBOX=off?)\n")
        1)
      (begin
        (display "aura-redis listening on 127.0.0.1:")
        (display (tcp-local-port L))
        (display " (loopback only; ")
        (display mode)
        (display ")\n")
        (let ((running #t))
          (while (lambda () running)
            (lambda ()
              (let ((c (tcp-accept L)))
                (if (integer? c)
                  (dispatch-client c)
                  (begin
                    (display "aura-redis: accept failed\n")
                    (set! running #f))))))
          (tcp-close L)
          0)))))
